title: Missing type hints on abstract method stubs
description:
**File:** python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py
**Lines:** 229-236, 245, 417-421

**Issue:** Abstract methods in `PacketProfile` and `_RplProfile` use `...` as body with missing or incomplete type hints:
- Line 229: `matches` missing return type annotation in parent (has `-> bool` but uses ellipsis without docstring)
- Line 232: `parse` - OK
- Line 236: `build` - OK
- Line 417-418: `_parse_base` and `_build_base` are abstract but undocumented

**Fix:** Add brief docstrings to abstract methods explaining their contract, especially `_parse_base` and `_build_base` which are internal.
